spec.description: Setup for case L19 of llm-dlc/loops/organic-java-merged-pr-links-l01-l20-brief.md, no claims. In the setup checkouts under ~/.cache/in-the-loop/merged-pr-links-l01-l20/worktrees (L19-kafka-fix = eab855541a4b776b150a849cecda9c758598cdca, L19-kafka-parent = a4f7675db1a928e73c7a69eb906dd1e9ecd4a22a; standalone depth-1 clones, because the build's grgit reads the repository with JGit), runs the upstream Gradle build (Gradle 5.4.1, sha256 checked against services.gradle.org; JDK 8u512; one init script adding a file repository with the jcenter-only build-script module grgit-core 3.1.1, SHA-1 checked; dependencies already resolved inline): kafka-streams and streams-test-utils jars and :streams:test for KStreamSessionWindowAggregateProcessorTest, SuppressScenarioTest and GraphGraceSearchUtilTest (core's Scala test classes are compiled for them), on the fix (first build may go online) then offline, on the parent offline, then the fix's three test files transplanted onto the parent (expected to fail or not compile). Copies each side's kafka-streams jar, the test-utils runtime classpath (project jars copied) and the class digests of the two changed classes into ~/.cache/in-the-loop/merged-pr-links-l01-l20/artifacts; JUnit summaries to .../logs; checkouts restored and cleaned. Results go into llm-dlc/loops/organic-java-merged-pr-links-l01-l20-brief-setup.md.
